title: AOS Evolve Failure Record
description: Redacted failure metadata captured from test/build/review failures.

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this error signature was first encountered.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this error signature was most recently encountered.

harness.description: Execution harness where failure occurred (claude, agy, opencode, codex).

error_sig.description: Normalized error signature hash or string used for deduplication.

redacted_excerpt.description: Sanitized error excerpt with home paths and secrets stripped.

trail_node.description: Associated AgentTrail node ID if available.

cwd_class.description: Category of working directory (e.g. worktree, scratch, repo).
